import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival rate by sex
survival_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 0].bar(survival_sex.index, survival_sex.values, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Sex')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 0].set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Survival rate by class
survival_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 1].bar(survival_class.index, survival_class.values, color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#EAFFD0'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Survival Rate by Class')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 1].set_ylim(0, 1)

# 3. Age distribution
axes[0, 2].hist(df['age'].dropna(), bins=10, color='#AA96DA', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Age Distribution')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 4. Fare distribution by class
for cls in df['class'].unique():
    cls_data = df[df['class'] == cls]['fare']
    axes[1, 0].hist(cls_data, alpha=0.6, label=cls, bins=10)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Fare')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[1, 0].legend()

# 5. Survival count by embark town
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 1], color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Survival Count by Embark Town')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Embark Town')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 1].legend(['Died', 'Survived'])
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Survival rate by sex and class
survival_sex_class = df.groupby(['sex', 'class'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_sex_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 2], color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#EAFFD0'])
axes[1, 2].set_title('Survival Rate by Sex and Class')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Sex')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[1, 2].legend(title='Class')
axes[1, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
